newsitem.title: USA: Uno Restaurant comfortable Q2 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Uno Restaurant comfortable Q2 estimates.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp Chief Financial Officer Robert Brown said Friday the company was comfortable with fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimates of $0.50 to $0.55, and second quarter estimates of $0.06 to $0.07.
He also said Uno expects third quarter earnings of $0.14 to $0.16 a share, and fourth quarter earnings of $0.21 to $0.23.

Speaking at a Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference, Brown said the company had experienced lower food costs in its fiscal first quarter, ended December 29, and expected the trend to continue over the next several quarters.

Addressing analysts at the conference, Chief Executive Craig Miller said the company planned to open eight company units this year and six to eight franchise units. "We feel good about our relative position versus the industry, particularly in the northeast," he said.
The company earned $0.13 per share, after charges, for fiscal 1996, ended September 29, 1996, and $0.09 in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
